rule.ai.claude-code.cache.consequence: Claude Code recreates these on its own. Pasted content is lost when you resume old conversations. Your sessions and history are not touched.
rule.ai.claude-code.logs.consequence: You lose old debug logs. Claude Code keeps working normally.
rule.ai.claude-code.old-versions.consequ: Old Claude Code versions (about {size}). The version in use stays; going back to an old one means reinstalling it.
rule.ai.cursor.cache.consequence: Cursor rebuilds its cache and may open slower the first time. Close Cursor first.
rule.ai.cursor.workspace-storage.consequ: You lose the agent chat history and saved state of those workspaces. This cannot be rebuilt.
rule.ai.windsurf.cache.consequence: Windsurf rebuilds its cache. Your conversations are not touched.
rule.ai.cursor.state-backups.consequence: You lose old backup copies of Cursor's state database. The current state and chat history are not touched. Close Cursor first.
rule.ai.claude-desktop.cache.consequence: The Claude app rebuilds its cache and may open slower the first time. Your conversations are not touched. Close Claude first.
rule.ai.vscode.old-extensions.consequenc: Older copies of extensions you already have in a newer version. The newest version stays. Close VS Code first.
rule.ai.cursor.old-extensions.consequenc: Older copies of extensions you already have in a newer version. The newest version stays. Close Cursor first.
rule.ai.copilot.cache.consequence: Copilot may ask you to sign in again.
rule.ai.codex.cache.consequence: You lose old Codex logs. Your sessions are not touched.
rule.ai.gemini.cache.consequence: You may lose session checkpoints, so you cannot restore those sessions.
rule.ai.aider.cache.consequence: Aider rebuilds its caches on the next run. Your chat history is not touched.
rule.ai.continue.cache.consequence: Continue reindexes your code on its own, which takes a while.
rule.models.ollama.consequence: The model will be downloaded again ({size}).
rule.models.lmstudio.consequence: The model will be downloaded again ({size}).
rule.models.huggingface.consequence: The model will be downloaded again ({size}).
rule.models.torch-hub.consequence: The model will be downloaded again ({size}).
rule.models.gpt4all.consequence: The model will be downloaded again ({size}).
rule.models.whisper.consequence: The model will be downloaded again ({size}).
rule.containers.build-cache.consequence: The next image builds will be slower. Space is freed inside the container engine's disk.
rule.containers.dangling-images.conseque: Untagged images no container uses are removed. Space is freed inside the container engine's disk.
rule.containers.stopped.consequence: You lose any data written inside those containers that is not in a volume.
rule.containers.unused-images.consequenc: Those images will be downloaded or built again when you need them.
rule.containers.volumes.consequence: You permanently lose the data in those volumes, including databases. This cannot be undone.
rule.pkg.npm.consequence: Packages will be downloaded again the next time a project needs them.
rule.pkg.npx.consequence: npx downloads these packages again the next time you run them.
rule.pkg.yarn.consequence: Packages will be downloaded again the next time a project needs them.
rule.pkg.bun.consequence: Packages will be downloaded again the next time a project needs them.
rule.pkg.pip.consequence: Packages will be downloaded again the next time a project needs them.
rule.pkg.uv.consequence: Packages will be downloaded again the next time a project needs them.
rule.pkg.poetry.consequence: Packages will be downloaded again the next time a project needs them.
rule.pkg.cargo.consequence: Packages will be downloaded again the next time a project needs them.
rule.pkg.gradle.consequence: Packages will be downloaded again the next time a project needs them.
rule.pkg.cocoapods.consequence: Packages will be downloaded again the next time a project needs them.
rule.pkg.homebrew.consequence: Old Homebrew downloads are removed. Installed packages keep working.
rule.pkg.pnpm.consequence: Projects link to this store. They stop working until you run pnpm install again.
rule.pkg.conda.consequence: Packages will be downloaded again when you create or update environments.
rule.pkg.rustup.consequence: Projects pinned to that toolchain will download it again.
rule.pkg.go.consequence: The next Go builds will be slower and modules will be downloaded again.
rule.pkg.maven.consequence: Every Maven dependency will be downloaded again, which can take a long time.
rule.pkg.playwright.consequence: Old Playwright browser versions (about {size}) are removed; the newest of each browser stays. A project pinned to an older Playwright downloads its browser again on the next install.
rule.apple.derived-data.consequence: Xcode rebuilds projects from scratch, so the next build is slower. Close Xcode first.
rule.apple.archives.consequence: You can no longer symbolicate crash reports or resubmit those published builds.
rule.apple.device-support.consequence: Xcode copies them again the next time you connect a device with that version.
rule.apple.sim-unavailable.consequence: Removes simulators whose runtime is no longer installed. Their apps and data are lost.
rule.apple.sim-runtimes.consequence: You must download the runtime again to use those simulators. The download is large.
rule.apple.previews.consequence: Xcode rebuilds SwiftUI previews the next time you open them.
rule.sys.user-caches.consequence: Apps recreate their caches and may open slower the first time.
rule.sys.sensitive-caches.consequence: Caches for Wallet and Apple Pay, your Apple Account, App Store and media accounts, Family Sharing, iCloud Mail and Home. You may have to sign in to your account again and wait for a resync.
rule.sys.logs.consequence: You lose old app logs that help diagnose problems.
rule.sys.crash-reports.consequence: You lose old crash reports. They can no longer be sent to developers.
rule.browser.cache.consequence: Sites load slower the first time. Cookies, passwords, history and extensions are not touched.
rule.proj.node-modules.consequence: Run your package manager's install in the project to get them back.
rule.proj.rust-target.consequence: The next cargo build of that project starts from scratch and is slower.
rule.proj.venv.consequence: You must recreate the environment and reinstall its packages. Anything installed by hand is lost.
rule.proj.build-dist.consequence: You must build the project again. Files kept only in these folders are lost.
report.unmanaged-note: Rain only shows the size of these folders. It never cleans them.
report.tool-total-note: Reported by the tool itself. Freeing it may not free the same space on your disk.
provider.unavailable.parse: {tool} returned output Rain could not read
